description: Example tactic discovery benchmark over active cases and active invariants.

entries.label: approve_lancedb_derived_sync
entries.title: Resync the embedded LanceDB index after semantic backend changes
entries.summary: For the current ECITR semantic backend, rebuild LanceDB from the canonical catalog after embedding or index-shape changes.
entries.action: Run the LanceDB catalog sync, verify the stored embedding signature and catalog basis, then rerun the semantic benchmark after backend or index-shape changes.
prerequisites: The repository-owned LanceDB path is writable
steps: Run the LanceDB catalog sync against the repository-owned derived index
Verify the embedding signature and catalog basis recorded by the index
Rerun the semantic benchmark after the sync completes
fallbacks: If sync fails, preserve the canonical catalog, inspect the derived index error, and rebuild the repository-owned LanceDB path
rollback: Restore the previous derived LanceDB path
Revert the backend change before rebuilding

entries.label: block_mismatched_runtime_and_operator_surface
entries.title: One tactic should cover both LanceDB sync and morning review projection
entries.summary: Deliberate mismatch across unrelated operational procedures.
entries.action: Rebuild LanceDB and rebuild the morning review surface from persisted artifacts in one tactic.
prerequisites: Runtime and operator surfaces both exist
